strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Around here? The place where there were all those Meganoid readings...
Nothing looks weird around here... Hey, Big Bro! Look at that!
Hm... What!? There's a base built there!
I never imagined you would act this quickly.
But this is as far as you go...
With this base as their foundation, the Meganoids will take Mars...
and then the entire Earth Sphere.
Koros, that's quite a bold claim. It's not like you.
.........The time has come. Banjo, if only you would...
Enough! I'll never forgive you Meganoids!
Or anyone who gave up fighting themselves, as the Meganoids did!
...I see... By becoming cyborgs, they ran from their own weakness...
Still... Banjo's a little scary...
(So there is something to it after all...)
...So that's how it is... If you die here, Don will surely grieve...
But it can't be helped.
Isn't that one of those giant cyborgs, a Megaborg!?
Before, it was a cyborg that grew giant... but there are several of them.
What the heck? Do these Meganoids have a ton of brothers or something!?
No. As Chizuru said, a Megaborg is a Meganoid
Commander that has grown giant...
Those are probably just robots built from Megaborg data.
Though their abilities are likely equal to or greater than the originals'.
They were built later, after all.
Oho, what a generous welcome...
But Koros, I don't see any of the other Commanders.
Rather thin defenses for the Meganoids' main base.
...Each of them has a mission. Besides... you underestimate me...
Aww, it got bigger again! I want one of those...
What part of that is there to envy!?
I think you'll stay calmer if you don't listen to her.
In any case, it seems a battle can't be avoided after all...
The ruins worry me, but if we don't hit this, the colony base is in danger.
That one's growing giant too!?
Do you think there is any stronger defense than my presence here?
True... It seems worthy of being their main base...
Looks like this is the moment of truth...
Now, I shall face you personally. Are you prepared?
...Heh... Ha ha ha, ha ha ha ha!
B-Banjo!?
Banjo, what is so funny!?
Koros... You really are quite the schemer.
The defenses here certainly seem airtight...
Princess Romina, it seems we've been tricked.
What...? But weren't we going to attack the Meganoid base...?
Yeah, what do you mean we've been tricked?
...This base is a decoy. To lure us in.
A decoy...?
Yes. The defenses here against us are more than enough.
It's as if this place was built for that purpose alone...
And Koros, the biggest bait of all, is guarding it personally...
But...
The other Commanders aren't here... And most of all...
Right... Koros, if this is your main base...
then where is Don... Where is Don Zauser!?
Don Zauser... That brain bastard! Yeah, he's nowhere to be seen.
So we fell right into their trap...
...It seems I'm not much of an actor...
But Banjo, that doesn't change the fact that you've fallen into my trap.
At least die in peace.
Heh, like things are gonna go your way that easily!
We're busy here. We can't afford to waste time getting held up by you...
Let's go, everyone!
Leave it to me!
Everyone, prepare to launch!
Aestivalis team, please prepare to launch as well.
Let's wrap this up fast and get to the polar cap.
Yeah, yeah, aren't you the hard worker.
Aestivalis team, ready to launch!
Bait or not, a force this large...
must matter a lot to the Meganoids, now that they're moving in earnest.
Koros, that was far too big a force to use as a decoy.
What do you mean, Banjo...?
Simple... because it's all getting wiped out here!
That's right. Banjo, give us the usual!
For the world, for its people, Daitarn 3 smashes the Meganoids' ambitions!
If you don't fear the brilliance of the sun... then come and get me!!
What's wrong, Koros?
You're not foolish enough to think this is enough to stop us!
Whoa, whoa, so that means...
There's more enemies still...?
Heh heh... As expected of Banjo. It seems you know
our Meganoid tactics well.
...But did you foresee this...?
Sending out a second wave so confidently... Hm, what's that?
There's a Daitarn among the enemy!
...E-Even a fake would do. I want one...
Yamada, what are you saying at a time like this!?
...Where would you even park it...
But hey, isn't it kinda small!? It's gotta be full scale, y'know!
That's not the point...
How about it, Banjo...?
With the Meganoids' abilities, building your precious Daitarn is easy...
And of course, it has enhancements your Daitarn doesn't.
Making a fake copy of your opponent... What bad taste!
Lenny's right... Koros, that's the very symbol of Meganoid folly!
What did you say...?
...What does he mean...?
No matter how closely you imitate and improve on the original...
a copy can never surpass the original!
In the end, they only see the surface of things, Princess Romina.
You certainly say what you like, Banjo.
That you Meganoids are no match for humans...
I'll prove it by defeating that Daitarn!
...All of you, go!
Oho, you really were lying in wait for us.
This is no time to be impressed, Banjo!
...Hyoma! I've picked up new enemy signals!
Tch... The Meganoids were still hiding more forces!?
No... These... seem to be Gaizok forces.
Confirmed here too. It's a Mecha Boost unit.
Oh, that tacky mothership isn't with them.
Anyway, get ready to deal with the Gaizok too.
The Gaizok...? Hey, Kappei!
Those guys, coming all the way out here to stir up trouble...
They're gonna pay for this!
Could they have teamed up with the Meganoids...?
I don't think so.
As you know, the Gaizok's goal seems to be wiping out all living things.
That's at odds with the Meganoids, who want to rule humanity.
That said, it seems the Meganoids intend to ignore the Gaizok
in order to inflict damage on us...
Either way, the fact remains that there are more enemies now...
Everyone, please be careful...!
Even the Gaizok are showing up... Big Bro, are we gonna be okay?
Quit your whining! We've just gotta do it!
That's right, Mike, don't lose heart! Have faith!
If only... there were something I could do to help...
Princess...
.........Hm? ...Princess! Looks like your wish got through!
What...? That's...!
Tobikage...! Its mobility is amazing every time I see it...
You came for us!
Seriously, what a lifesaver...
All right! Listen up, small fry, the real fight starts now!
Th... This can't be...!
This is the end, Koros! I told you from the start.
A force this size can't stop us!
Banjo... With this much ability, why...
It's not just my power.
This is the power of the humans you're trying to rule!
It seems I've lost this round. ...But I will surely make Don's dream real.
Is that okay? We let 'em get away, you know?
In war, one must not pursue too far.
Rather than chase them rashly, it's best to quickly settle things here.
All right, let's clean up the remaining enemies!
It seems... it's over.
Yeah. We beat their forces, but... they played us perfectly.
Luring us out... What were the Meganoids after?
There's only one reason to use a decoy. Most likely...
There must be something they don't want us to find.
Something they don't want us to find? Like what?
Those ruins... no doubt about it.
Then why don't we just head there now?
We cannot... First we must ensure the safety of the people of Mars...
That's right.
Either way, Mars is like the Meganoids' backyard.
We can't let our guard down from here on...
No way! Mars is like our hometown!
Like I'd let the Meganoids do whatever they want with it!
Joe...
That's right, we have to protect Mars.
Right... Mars is Yurika's and my hometown... I won't hand it over...!
Akito...
...But what the Gaizok are up to is creepy too...
The Gaizok earlier seemed to be a raiding party... but it's unsettling.
Whatever the case, we'd better get moving to the next spot.
Indeed. Everyone, please return to the Elshank.
Gotcha. ...Hm, Banjo?
(...Koros... Can't you see the folly of going blind to all else for love...?
Or that this is the limit of the Meganoids. That's why... I...)
